english.title: Provide false statistical information to OFCOM required under section 32 - wireless telegraphy
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in pursuance of a requirement of OFCOM under section 32 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006, provided information that was false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION AND PARTICULAR..), knowing it to be false or being reckless as to whether or not it was false
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(4) and (5) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) Section 105 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 makes special provisions for this offence in relation to ships and aircraft.
(ii) Section 107 of the Act provides for proceedings and enforcement where this offence has been committed in UK territorial sea.
(iii) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(iv) Schedule 4 of the Act provides for fixed penalty notices for this offence.
(v) The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011, (In force 01/10/2011), introduces a £100-00p fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act, as from that date. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed Penalty charge of £100-00p (in force from 01/10/2011).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
